# balena_user_public_key (Data Source)

Reads the one user public key (the `user_public_key` resource of the `/v7` API) that matches every configured attribute. At least one attribute must be set, and exactly one row must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "balena_user_public_key" "example" {
  id = 123456
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the user public key. Selects the row when configured.
- `public_key` (String) API field `public_key` (text). At most 2850 characters. Changing it replaces the resource. Selects the row when configured.
- `title` (String) API field `title` (short text). At most 120 characters. Selects the row when configured.
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the referenced `user` (API field `user`). Changing it replaces the resource. Selects the row when configured.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) API field `created_at` (date time).
